why: The upstream repositories carry their demo apps' screenshots and videos in their history: resolving them as remote packages cloned about 2 GB (LNPopupUI 930 MB, LNPopupController about as much), which held every clean build, Xcode Cloud's included, for half an hour and more (2026-11-05), and would need four more repositories authorized in Xcode Cloud. Only the sources are vendored. Yuedu uses LNPopupUI for the now-playing bar the audiobook player opens out of and folds back into (NowPlayingPopupHost).

patches.change: LNPopupController and LNSwiftUIUtils by path (../LNPopupController, ../LNSwiftUIUtils) instead of by URL; upstream keeps these lines commented out for its own local development.

removeWhen: Delete these four Packages/LN* folders and add https://github.com/LeoNatan/LNPopupUI as a remote package again, if its history is ever trimmed.
